tactical_thesis: Eliminate the unfunded Spot handoff and give permanent lower-outer interception, eastern roadblock clearance and artillery-hit absorption to Melantha. Separate the physicians: Hibiscus covers Midnight and Fang; Ansel covers Friston, Melantha and eastern Steward. This changes the failed continuous-Melantha structure by changing actual healing coverage and reducing medical splash coupling. Steward retains the artillery-to-central-to-western rotation. This is a complete, unsimulated seven-ID hypothesis, not a verified WIN; lower medical competition and central queue clearance remain decisive unresolved conditions.
